port_difficulty.why: One IEFBR14 step, no DDs, no program logic; the only behavior is the scheduler condition handling.

blast_radius.why: First link of the nightly chain; it waits on EXTERNAL-FEED, which nothing in the tree sets, so if the feed is late or missing JOBA and JOBB never run and nothing abends.

units.driving_fact: JOBA gates on INCOND EXTERNAL-FEED (nightly.xml line 5), set by something outside this tree, and sets JOBA-DONE (line 6) that releases JOBB.

port_difficulty.why: One IEFBR14 step, but the scheduler semantics are subtle: it deletes the JOBA-DONE condition it consumed, and a refactor target must reproduce that.

blast_radius.why: Second link of the nightly chain; it clears JOBA-DONE (line 10) so a rerun or restart changes the chain silently, but IEFBR14 itself writes nothing.

units.driving_fact: JOBB consumes JOBA-DONE and then removes it with SIGN=- (nightly.xml line 10), so a re-run of JOBB will wait again until JOBA reruns.
